release_notes.headline_internal: Coordination reports now surface evidence-gated refactor coverage with safe dry-run referrals
highlights: New Phase 6.5 Refactor Coverage Audit in /adv-coordinate classifies out-of-date changes and Epics into actionable, Epic-coverage, and review/deferred groups
Actionable change candidates get a dry-run /adv-refactor <change-id> referral pinned to the bare form; emitting --execute, --interactive, --force, or batch from coordination is explicitly forbidden

Epic findings name the exact stale field and route to the existing approval-gated adv_epic_update / adv_epic_reorder / adv_epic_show paths; no Epic target is ever offered to /adv-refactor, which has no Epic mode
judgment_call, freshness_limited, and unresolved-evidence candidates are listed for review with no mutation command
Referrals record candidate status at emit time and advise re-validation, since /adv-refactor has no explicit terminal-state guard
Audit consumes evidence already gathered by Phases 1, 3, and 6 — no new tool call and no new mutation authority
Known limitation: the audit does not run when Phase 1 short-circuits on no active Epics; stated in the contract text
